SELECT @rownum:=@rownum+1 rownum, INDENTIFY_MARK AS indentifyMark, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK AS orgIndentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE AS bankCode, IS_BELONG_BANK AS isBelongBank, THE_BANK_NAME AS theBankName, THE_BANK_CODE AS theBankCode, HOLDER_MARK AS holderMark, HOLDER_REGION AS holderRegion, HOLDER_TYPE AS holderType, PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE AS personalIdentifyType, INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE AS institutionIdentifyType, IDENTIFY_NUMBER AS identifyNumber, SPV_CAP_ACC_BANK AS spvCapAccBank, OTHER_CAP_ACC_BANK AS otherCapAccBank, SPV_REGIST_CODE AS spvRegistCode, HOLDER_DATE holderDate, HOLDER_NAME holderName, HOLDER_SEX holderSex, HOLDER_RISK_PREFER AS holderRiskPrefer, HOLDER_CELLPHONE AS holderCellphone, HOLDER_TELEPHONE AS holderTelephone, HOLDER_EMAIL AS holderEmail, TYPE AS type, OTHER_IDENTIFY_NAME AS otherIdentifyName, REMARK, SUBMIT_STATUS AS submitStatus, SUBMIT_TIME AS submitTime, CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE AS chbSubmitDeadline, SUBMIT_DEADLINE AS submitDeadline, STATUS AS STATUS, t1.UPDATE_TIME AS updateTime, t2.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS AS submitFeedbackStatus, IF( @INDENTIFY_MARK = t1.INDENTIFY_MARK, @rank := @rank + 1, @rank := 1 ) AS rank, @INDENTIFY_MARK := t1.INDENTIFY_MARK FROM ( SELECT @rownum := 0, @INDENTIFY_MARK := NULL, @rank := 0 )b, ( SELECT * FROM chb_view_equ_sub ORDER BY INDENTIFY_MARK,update_time DESC) t1 INNER JOIN CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS t2 ON t1.SUMIT_SEQ = t2.SEQNO
t2.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03' and t1.INDENTIFY_MARK=#{indentifyMark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and t1.REGIST_BANK_CODE=#{bankCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK orgIndentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE bankCode, IS_BELONG_BANK isBelongBank, THE_BANK_NAME theBankName, THE_BANK_CODE theBankCode, HOLDER_MARK holderMark, HOLDER_REGION holderRegion, HOLDER_TYPE holderType, PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE personalIdentifyType, INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE institutionIdentifyType, OTHER_IDENTIFY_NAME otherIdentifyName, IDENTIFY_NUMBER identifyNumber, SPV_CAP_ACC_BANK spvCapAccBank, OTHER_CAP_ACC_BANK otherCapAccBank, SPV_REGIST_CODE spvRegistCode, HOLDER_DATE holderDate, HOLDER_NAME holderName, HOLDER_SEX holderSex, HOLDER_RISK_PREFER holderRiskPrefer, HOLDER_CELLPHONE holderCellphone, HOLDER_TELEPHONE holderTelephone, HOLDER_EMAIL holderEmail, ORG_CODE orgCode, DEPT_CODE deptCode, REMARK remark FROM CHB_EQU_HOLD HOLD
AND concat_ws('',REGIST_BANK_CODE, '_', IDENTIFY_NUMBER, '_', HOLDER_NAME, '_', PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE,, '_', INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE, '_', OTHER_IDENTIFY_NAME) IN
#{key,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND STATUS !='D' /*未报送*/ AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM CHB_EQU_SUB T INNER JOIN CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS T2 ON T.SUMIT_SEQ = T2.SEQNO AND T2.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03' WHERE HOLD.INDENTIFY_MARK = T.INDENTIFY_MARK )
UNION ALL
SELECT INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK orgIndentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE bankCode, IS_BELONG_BANK isBelongBank, THE_BANK_NAME theBankName, THE_BANK_CODE theBankCode, HOLDER_MARK holderMark, HOLDER_REGION holderRegion, HOLDER_TYPE holderType, PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE personalIdentifyType, INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE institutionIdentifyType, OTHER_IDENTIFY_NAME otherIdentifyName, IDENTIFY_NUMBER identifyNumber, SPV_CAP_ACC_BANK spvCapAccBank, OTHER_CAP_ACC_BANK otherCapAccBank, SPV_REGIST_CODE spvRegistCode, HOLDER_DATE holderDate, HOLDER_NAME holderName, HOLDER_SEX holderSex, HOLDER_RISK_PREFER holderRiskPrefer, HOLDER_CELLPHONE holderCellphone, HOLDER_TELEPHONE holderTelephone, HOLDER_EMAIL holderEmail, ORG_CODE orgCode, DEPT_CODE deptCode, REMARK remark FROM CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK HOLDCHECK WHERE 1=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHB_EQU_HOLD HOLD WHERE ifnull(HOLD.REGIST_BANK_CODE,'') = ifnull(HOLDCHECK.REGIST_BANK_CODE ,'') AND ifnull(HOLD.IDENTIFY_NUMBER,'') = ifnull(HOLDCHECK.IDENTIFY_NUMBER,'') AND ifnull(HOLD.HOLDER_NAME,'') = ifnull(HOLDCHECK.HOLDER_NAME,'') AND ifnull(HOLD.PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE,'') = ifnull(HOLDCHECK.PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE,'') AND ifnull(HOLD.INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE,'') = ifnull(HOLDCHECK.INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE,'') AND ifnull(HOLD.OTHER_IDENTIFY_NAME,'') = ifnull(HOLDCHECK.OTHER_IDENTIFY_NAME,'') AND ifnull(HOLD.INDENTIFY_MARK,'') = ifnull(HOLDCHECK.INDENTIFY_MARK,'')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHB_EQU_SUB SUB INNER JOIN CHB_SUBMIT_STATUS T2 ON SUB.SUMIT_SEQ = T2.SEQNO AND T2.SUBMIT_FEEDBACK_STATUS = '03' WHERE (HOLDCHECK.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK = SUB.INDENTIFY_MARK OR HOLDCHECK.MERGER_INDENTIFY_MARK = SUB.ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK))
AND concat_ws('',HOLDCHECK.REGIST_BANK_CODE, '_', HOLDCHECK.IDENTIFY_NUMBER, '_', HOLDCHECK.HOLDER_NAME, '_', HOLDCHECK.PERSONAL_IDENTIFY_TYPE,, '_', HOLDCHECK.INSTITUTION_IDENTIFY_TYPE, '_', HOLDCHECK.OTHER_IDENTIFY_NAME) IN
#{key,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
